nodes.label: Gate 9 Evidence (Source Stabilization)
nodes.description: Gate 9 verified for fixture-backed frontend matrix. M02/M03/M04/M05: no source defect requiring change. M06: global 44px min touch-target CSS present. M07: SensorReadingChart ResizeObserver handling. M08: all routes use dynamic imports. Browser evidence (Playwright against live Docker): horizontal overflow PASS at all viewports, touch targets PASS (≥44px), modal accessibility PASS (role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape, return focus), no-polling gate GREEN for guest (33s observation, 0 recurring). Graph boundary: fail-closed default (no sensor has public_monitoring_enabled=true). Task 12 fresh rerun: 33/33 clean across 320/360/390/768/1024/1280/1440 with guest/user/admin plus empty/dense/long fixtures.
nodes.rationale: Proves the responsive/a11y hardening is complete for the fixture-backed matrix. The 33/33 clean pass across all viewports and roles, plus the modal accessibility and no-polling gate, are the key Gate 9 deliverables.
